race.comment: DECORUM (6) talented gelding who produced excellent figures first up with a devastating win from the wide gate over 1200m at Randwick in BM78 class. Held in high regard by the stable and will relish the fast tempo from the right draw. Hard to stop. RUINATION (11) struggled in stakes grade last time in and has clearly strengthened over the break. Beat a handy field first up, then peaked late in a fast run race when fourth over 1200m at this track. Has further upside from the draw and can take a hand in the finish. CROSS TASMAN (3) started a dominant favourite on resumption with a narrow second over 1400m in the Goulburn Cup. Undefeated second up and since kept up to the mark with a 1050m trial placing. Leading contender. ALABAMA STATE (14) can surprise in this grade on the limit.
